text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"तथा च । युद्धं न तावत्सुकरं न च युद्धं तथा भयंकरम् ।","english":"War is not as easily provoked by living beings as it is terrible;","kind":"sense","why":"The English mistranslates the comparison of ease and terror as a statement about provocation by living beings.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[{"english":"The Chakravaka says, \"O King, war is not to be done first, because he is no servant and he is no minister who, at the beginning, advises the King to rush into war or to leave his own place without consideration."}]}

contradictions.source: तथा च । युद्धं न तावत्सुकरं न च युद्धं तथा भयंकरम् ।
contradictions.english: War is not as easily provoked by living beings as it is terrible;
contradictions.why: The English mistranslates the comparison of ease and terror as a statement about provocation by living beings.

additions.english: The Chakravaka says, "O King, war is not to be done first, because he is no servant and he is no minister who, at the beginning, advises the King to rush into war or to leave his own place without consideration.
